messages.subject: [statnet_help] standardized coefficients in ERGMs
messages.body_plain:
Dear Statnet community,

I am trying to compare the strength of an edge attribute across ERGMs with different outcome objects. I am wondering how do we talk about effect sizes in the ERGM world? Are the "regression" coefficients generated from ERGMs standardized? If not, is there a way to do so?

Any information would be appreciated. Thank you!

Jing Chen, Ph.D.
Assistant professor
Shanghai Jiao Tong University
